Method of Attack: Backdoor access to compromised macOS systems
Commands to control system and exfiltrate data
Persistence via modifying system files, Cron jobs, LaunchAgents, and ~/.zshrc
Communication with C2 servers for registration, task execution, and data exfiltration
Execution of arbitrary shell commands, file upload/download, process management, and user interaction
Impacted Systems: macOS (Intel-based x86_64 and ARM Apple Silicon architectures)
Attack Vector: Distributed as Visual Studio for Mac updater under multiple names (e.g., 'zshrc2', 'Previewers', 'VisualStudioUpdater', 'VisualStudioUpdater_Patch', 'VisualStudioUpdating', 'visualstudioupdate', 'DO_NOT_RUN_ChromeUpdates')
Indicators of Compromise: Binaries and download domains associated with RustDoor
Artifacts and IoCs suggesting possible relation to ALPHV/BlackCat and BlackBasta ransomware operators
